mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing ibuprofen metabolism competition; ibuprofen may increase modafinil levels via CYP3A4 inhibition, and both drugs can affect renal function and fluid retention.
action: Monitor for increased modafinil effects (insomnia, anxiety, headache) and ibuprofen GI side effects; consider alternative analgesics or dose adjustment if combined therapy necessary.
